adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `tokenInfo` is set via `refreshOAuthTokens(...)` and then the code accesses `tokenInfo.data.error` / `tokenInfo.data` (Axios-style). But `refreshOAuthTokens` returns a `fetch(...)` Response object when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` is true, and a `Response` has no `.data`, so this will throw at runtime in sync mode. Also, the call passes `credentialId` as the third argument (`refreshOAuthTokens(..., "zoho-bigin", credentialId)`), but in the shown scope only `credential`/`credentialKey` are referenced; `credentialId` is not defined in the diff hunk, which would cause a TS compile error if it’s truly not declared elsewhere in the file.
